cohort: 465 women with twin pregnancies in Poland in 2012
finding: Monochorionic twin pregnancies were associated with a higher risk of preterm delivery, cesarean delivery, lower neonatal birth weight, and increased perinatal mortality and neonatal complications compared to dichorionic twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed in 432 patients (92.9%).
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was statistically lower in the MC group (2074 g vs. 2370 g; p < 0.001).
